sentences.text: Participant B (Sarah) stated that the meeting is the first one for the group.
Participant B outlined the meeting agenda, which includes getting to know each other, tool training, discussing the project plan, and sharing ideas.
Participant B stated the meeting has twenty-five minutes.
Participant B described the project goal as developing an original remote control that is trendy, appealing to a wide market (including grannies, kids, and dogs), user-friendly, a
Participant B explained the project structure involves three phases: functional design, conceptual design, and detailed design.
Participant B announced they will lead the drawing activity first.
Participant B drew a tiger and described it as majestic, independent, and proud.
Participant A volunteered to go next.
Participant A drew a cat and identified it as sitting.
Participant A described the cat as supportive, a best friend that does not discriminate, loyal, and having intuition (able to distinguish between a thief and a person).
Participant D volunteered to draw.
Participant D initially intended to draw a T. rex, then changed to a pelican, and finally settled on a crocodile.
Participant D described the crocodile as scary and strong.
Participant C volunteered to draw.
Participant C initially intended to draw a big cat, then an eagle, and finally settled on an eagle.
Participant C described the eagle as free-spirited and birds of prey as intrepid.
Participant B stated the selling price is twenty-five euros.
Participant A estimated the conversion rate as one point four euros to one pound.
Participant D estimated the price as seventeen pounds.
Participant C suggested making notes of the price conversion for later reference.
Participant B agreed that notes should be taken and mentioned the possibility of putting them in a shared folder.
Participant D noted that market remote controls currently cost about twenty pounds.
Participant D mentioned they had to buy one of the market remote controls.
Participant C stated that the product should be accessible and usable by all age groups, excluding the business market.
Participant C noted that the target group is 'everyone' and the product must be user-friendly for all users.
Participant B mentioned that the production cost is 12.50.
Participant B stated that half of the selling price is taken up by building the product.
Participant B indicated that the profit aim is 50 million euros.
Participant C clarified that the 50 million euro profit aim is for the first year.
Participant B expressed a preference for a remote control design where main functions are on the front and other functions open up in a section, rather than having too many buttons
Participant B described their dislike for remote controls with 'a million tiny little buttons with tiny little words' and searching for specific buttons like teletext.
Participant C mentioned their experience with remote controls is limited to basic functions (on/off, volume, channel) without tampering or programming.
Participant C stated that they do not think they could use a remote control with more complex programming features.
Participant C suggested that incorporating an LCD display with a menu, similar to mobile phones, might be useful for navigation.
Participant A agreed with the idea of using an LCD display or menu system similar to mobile phones to simplify the interface.
Participant B stated that their grandad can answer his mobile phone but cannot text.
Participant D noted that their grandad is better than them at using teletext.
Participant C identified that older generation users may not be able to program their remote controls, regardless of design modifications.
Participant B expressed a dislike for new phones with Windows-based running systems, describing them as confusing.
Participant B described their experience with a friend's new phone where they 'kept getting lost' due to the interface.
Participant D questioned how much of an excellent screen could be obtained for a price of 20 or 12.50 euros.
Participant D suggested that for the older generation, an extra button for large print might be necessary.
